title: Otori Emu — Enter Count Otori!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh where, oh where could they be☆
Aha!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Morning, everyone! Time for a wonderhoy blitz♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Eep!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?! Hey, you guys managed to dodge me♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We managed?!
Don't put us in this position in the first place!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. As energetic as ever, I see.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Too energetic if you ask me...
I mean, it's still too early for this. I thought my heart was gonna stop...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe☆ Sorry if I startled you guys, but there's something I wanna tell you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tell us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you have news regarding the bridal fair you told us about the other day? I heard that it attracted quite a crowd.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! It wasn't all just grown-ups either. Lots of people our age came to see dresses with their friends and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They saw all the pretty dresses on display and said that they hoped to get to wear them someday in the future, and some even tried them on at the fair!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I see. After all, a wedding dress means something special to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, you should've seen how their eyes sparkled when they tried them on!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Their friends were totally dazzled when they saw someone they know wearing one. Some of them looked a little embarrassed, but everyone seemed to have a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh yeah, how'd the wedding show go?
Did you guys end up using our idea?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We did!
Everyone seemed to really enjoy performing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? You sound perplexed.
Did you forget that we planned it together?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know it was our idea, but I still wasn't sure if a vampire barging in on someone's wedding would actually work as a plot.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it must've been quite staggering at first.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, Emu, how did it go in practice?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: People were surprised. They really didn't know what to do!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But once they realized that all they had to do was ring the bell, they began to really enjoy it♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They must've felt more comfortable after figuring out the task at hand, even if they couldn't fully grasp the situation.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, some of the pairs were acting kind of uncomfortable after actually putting the wedding wear on.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But after the show started, they went right back to their happy selves for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that could be because they weren't used to seeing each other in something so glamorous...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. But it seems our show provided just the distraction they needed from those nerves.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: See?! Which means a vampire was the right choice!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, calm down.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
Honami and her friends decided to participate♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I gave her one of the tickets my brothers gave me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then, Honami, Kanade and Mizuki all came together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, Yoisaki was there?
Wait, did you also say Akiyama?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yoisaki offered an invitation because she knew Mizuki likes to make collages and alterations to clothing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You knew?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mizuki shared some thoughts with me about our show idea.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our little twist elicited surprise, but the show proved enjoyable in the end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That being said, Mizuki was in the audience while Mochizuki and Yoisaki played the main characters.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Interesting... I can kind of see Mochizuki performing in a show, but not Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Honami and Kanade were both startled in the beginning, but they worked really hard together to ring the bell♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, you just want Kanade to have fun today...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, that was the plan.
But it sort of ended up having the opposite effect.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I didn't realize it would be this difficult...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm really glad Honami and Kanade had so much fun in the end.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just remembered the way they smiled at the end, and I'm feeling happy all over again♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It wasn't just Honami and the others!
Our show made so many people smile from ear to ear!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you guys so much for your advice!

rows.Speaker: Rui, Tsukasa & Nene
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well, enough chatter for now.
I believe it's about time we began practicing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks for listening!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks for telling us what happened. I've been meaning to ask you about it for a little while now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, shall we get started?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu & Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yeah.
